items.brief: Gerald Charles gives its baroque-shaped Maestro a limited turquoise colourway, keeping up the brand's link to tennis.

items.title: The Tissot Supersport NBA turns the shot clock into a surprisingly sleek-looking chronograph
items.author: Tom Austin
items.brief: Tissot puts a 24-second shot clock on the bezel and a court-inspired dial on a grey Supersport chronograph.

items.title: Accutron heads into haute horlogerie with high frequency movements and grand complications
items.author: Rob Corder
items.brief: Accutron's autumn/winter collection debuts two in-house movements as the brand pushes upmarket.

items.title: TimeForArt Auction Spotlight: Gerald Charles × Igor Mitoraj Luci di Nara
items.author: Mike Espindle
items.brief: A Gerald Charles piece inspired by Igor Mitoraj's sculpture, previewed ahead of December's Phillips charity sale.

items.title: Tissot drops new NBA watch inspired by technical sportswear
items.author: Ella Kirby
items.brief: Tissot's new Supersport NBA edition goes monochrome grey, a quieter look than last year's.

items.title: Watch Review: Chopard Happy Sport 36mm In Lucent Steel
items.author: David Bredan
items.brief: A review of the 36mm Happy Sport, the watch Chopard credits with first pairing diamonds and steel, and of its 1970s origins.

items.title: Awake looks to nature for inspiration for three new Frosted Leaf models
items.author: Andrew O'Connor
items.brief: Awake's Sơn Mài collection gains three dials, Blood Moon, Storm and Lagoon, each in hand-worked silver-leaf lacquer.

items.title: The watch fair is dead. Long live the new watch fair
items.author: Ella Kirby
items.brief: Lex Borrero and Perri Dash on Time To Drive, a car-and-watch festival launching in Miami this November.
